sections.title: Confidant Abilities
head: Rank
Ability
rows:
Group Guillotine:
Allows you to fuse three Personas to create powerful new ones.

Lockdown:
Allows you to leave a Persona to learn an attribute resistance.

Special Treatment:
Allows you to pay to create Personas of a higher level.

Guillotine Booster:
Increases the possible fusions of Personas in Group Guillotine (4+).

VIP Treatment:
Reduces the amount of money needed for Special Treatment.

sections.title: Rank Up Progression
head: Rank
Requirements / Dialogue Choices
rows:
Have a Jack Frost that knows Mabufu
(fusion unlocked at Lv. 11)

Jack Frost learns Mabufu at Lv 12
OR
Arsene + Agathion = Succubus
Succubus + Pixie = Cait Sith
Cait Sith + Regent (Mabufu) = Jack Frost

Have an Ame-no-Uzume with Frei
(fusion unlocked at Lv. 16)

Hua Po + Berith = Suzaku
Berith + Suzaku (Frei) = Ame-no-Uzume

Have a Flauros with Tarukaja
(fusion unlocked at Lv. 19)

Berith + Regent = Orobas
Jack-o'-Lantern + Angel = Eligor
Berith + Orobas + Eligor (Tarukaja) = Flauros

Have a Phoenix with Counter
(fusion unlocked at Lv. 21)

Hua Po + Jack-o'-Lantern = Yaksini
Kodama + Flauros = Oni
Yaksini (Counter) + Oni (Counter) = Phoenix

Have a Setanta with Rakukaja
(fusion unlocked at Lv. 25)

Jack-o'-Lantern + Agathion = Silky
Suzaku + Kaguya Picaro = Lamia
Silky + Lamia (Rakukaja) = Setanta
OR
Berith (Rakukaja) + Hua Po = Suzaku (Rakukaja)
Suzaku (Rakukaja) + Phoenix = Setanta

Have a Neko Shogun with Dekaja
(fusion unlocked at Lv. 30)

High Pixie + Orobas (Dekaja) = Sudama (Dekaja)
Flauros + Ariadne = Anzu (also learns Dekaja at Lv 28)
Kodama + Anzu + Sudama (Dekaja) = Neko Shogun

Have a Lachesis with Tetraja
(fusion unlocked at Lv. 35)

Ariadne + Jack Frost = Principality
Pixie + Principality (Tetraja) = Anubis (Tetraja)
Tam Lin + Anubis (Tetraja) = Lachesis
OR
Clotho learns Tetraja at Lv 28
Clotho (Tetraja) + Stone of Scone = Lachesis

Have a Hecatoncheires with Masukunda
(fusion unlocked at Lv. 42)

Hua Po + Thoth (Masukunda) = Andras (Masukunda)
- Anzu + Andras (Masukunda) = Hecatoncheires
OR
Lilim learns Masukunda at Lv 34
Lilim (Masukunda) + Anzu = Hecatoncheires

Have a Bugs with Samarecarm
(fusion unlocked at Lv. 49)

Requires completing "The Lovesick Cyberstalking Girl"
request (July 10)

Hariti learns Samarecarm at Lv 41
Izanagi Picaro + Oni = Pisaca
Sandman + Orobas = Pisaca
Pixie + Pisaca + Hariti (Samarecarm) = Bugs

Have a Seth with High Counter
(fusion unlocked at Lv. 51)

Bicorn + Kaguya Picaro (High Counter) = Isis (High Counter)
Anubis + Thoth + Horus + Isis (High Counter) = Seth
OR
Dakini learns High Counter at Lv 52
Dakini (High Counter) + Ame-no-Uzume = Anubis (High Counter)
Anubis (High Counter) + Thoth + Horus + Isis = Seth
